name: m8-a0-automation-integration
title: M8-A0 Automation Coordinator and Sync Integration
description: Own one automatic sync-then-catalog-scrape lane while keeping sync transport, catalog scraping, and future provider traffic isolated.
scope: app/lib/store/library_index_service.dart, app/lib/store/sync_engine.dart, app/lib/store/automation_coordinator.dart, app/lib/ui/sync_panel.dart, app/lib/ui/scrape_panel.dart, app/rust/src/scraper.rs, app/rust/src/catalog_context.rs, app/rust/src/api/db.rs, app/rust/src/api/scraper.rs, app/rust/src/db/mod.rs, app/rust/src/scrape_projection.rs, app/rust/src/sync/snapshot.rs, app/rust/examples/catalog_dry_run.rs, app/rust/examples/catalog_materialize_dry_run.rs
creator: cfl
notes: Catalog-rules-v3 offline parser, durable catalog queue, physical asset identity, persisted local/Quark/115 context normalization, run accounting, coordinator ordering, UI status and sync-boundary regression are implemented. Final semantic follow-up adds ancestor leading-attribution normalization, upper/lower chapter-part evidence, collection/completeness separation, and full-color state. Production safe-auto materialization is enabled for Ready proposals with empty conflicts; canonical writes remain local transactions and sync push remains a separate coordinator step. The isolated pass reports input_assets=389, unique_assets=389, proposals_written=389, asset_collision_count=0, accounting_status=pass; remote_book_source_io/provider_requests/content_reads are all false. The isolated materialization copy pass applied 389/389 proposals, created 397 canonical metadata rows, 169 tags and 2250 links, and invoked no sync transport. After a matching backup was created, the production database was materialized locally: 389/389 applied, 397 metadata rows, 169 tags and 2250 links; a rerun skipped all 389 rows, proving idempotency. Final exports: docs/reports/catalog-dry-run-2026-08-23-after-semantic-fixes.json, docs/reports/catalog-materialize-dry-run-2026-08-23.json and docs/reports/catalog-materialize-production-apply-2026-08-23.json.
